mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate above 7.5% triggers negative labor market sentiment, leading to reduced corporate investment and lower equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.2pp in 1 month but SPX 20d returns are negative, or 20d returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices above historical averages creates a balanced economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO both above 5-year averages but their combined effect on SPX 60d returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, sustained FEDFUNDS rates below 2% lower long-term interest rates, boosting equity present value and driving positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <2% in an easing cycle but SPX 5d returns are not positive, or returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Continued monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 5% strengthens labor market confidence, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and supporting positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS monthly growth >5% but SPX 20d returns are not positively correlated (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 100 indicates robust economic activity, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering investor optimism for positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 100 but SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside higher FEDFUNDS rates signals tightening monetary policy despite strong demand, creating market uncertainty and negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS both rising but their combined effect on SPX 20d returns is negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with high inflation (CPIAUCSL >240), elevated core inflation erodes equity valuations, leading to negative 5-day forward returns despite expansionary signals.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL >240 in late-cycle expansion but SPX 5d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).
